svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.10.14.5 Construction of Exposing Building Face and Walls above Exposing Building Face
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.10 FIRE PROTECTION
Construction of Exposing Building Face and Walls above Exposing Building Face

g.text: Face and wall above it, Sentence (1)
built to Table 9.10.14.5.-A, including the gable
face and sides as for a limiting distance under 1.2 m,
underside protected: more than 0.6 m (1′-11⅝″) above ground
Two dwelling units, one above the other
not within 0.45 m (1′-5¾″) of the property line,
where the limiting distance is more than 0.45 m
Within 1.2 m of the line, Sentence (12)
no openings, protected by 0.38 mm (0.015″) sheet steel,
unvented aluminum, 12.7 mm (½″) gypsum board, 11 mm
(7/16″) plywood, 12.5 mm (½″) OSB, or 11 mm lumber
Drawn: limiting distance 1.5 m (4′-11″), roof cut back.
Roof soffit near a property line
TABLE 9.10.14.5.-A MINIMUM CONSTRUCTION FOR EXPOSING BUILDING FACES

svg.text: WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
Construction to Table 9.10.14.5.-A, and cladding that may be combustible
(1) Faces, and exterior walls above them enclosing an attic or roof space,
conform to the Table, except as in (3) to (14). Note A-9.10.14.5.(1): minor
combustible cladding elements such as trim are permitted where distributed over
the face. See also 9.10.8. (2) Over 10% openings, where the wall assembly meets
Clause 3.1.5.5.(1)(b) tested to CAN/ULC-S134, except as in (3) to (8). (3) Over
25% to 50% openings, where (a) limiting distance (LD) is over 5.0 m (16′-4⅞″),
(b) LD is over 2.5 m (8′-2⅜″) with the face to Table 9.10.14.5.-B, (c) building
or fire compartment sprinklered, (d) cladding to 9.27.6. to 9.27.9., on no
furring or furring up to 25 mm (1″), over 12.7 mm (½″) gypsum sheathing or
masonry, flame-spread rating 25 or less after ASTM D2898 conditioning, or (e)
cladding to 9.27.12., over 12.7 mm gypsum sheathing or masonry, flame-spread
rating 25 or less, 2 mm (0.079″) thick or less. Ratings per 3.1.12.1.(2). Except
as in (4) to (8) and per (9).
Garages, accessory buildings, columns and components
(4) A detached garage or accessory building for one dwelling unit only: no Table
rating at LD 0.6 m (1′-11⅝″) or more, at least 45 min below 0.6 m, and no Table
cladding or construction type. (5) Rating, construction and cladding need not
apply to its face toward that dwelling unit, on the same property, where it is
the only major occupancy. (13) Heavy timber and steel columns at LD 3 m
(9′-10⅛″) or more are exempt from (1). (14) No rating for non-loadbearing wall
components of a 1 storey, noncombustible, low-hazard industrial building for low
fire load uses only (such as power-generating plants or plants for
noncombustible materials), at LD 3 m or more.
Projections
(6) Combustible projections over 1 m (3′-3⅜″) above ground that could expose an
adjacent building: not within 1.2 m (3′-11¼″) of a property line or public way
centre line, or 2.4 m (7′-10½″) of a combustible projection on another building
on the same property. (7) Not for buildings of one or two dwelling units only,
or garages and accessory buildings as in (5), except as in (9) to (12). (8) Such
projections totally enclosed with solid faces (fireplaces, chimneys) within 1.2
m of a property line: (a) face and sides as for LD under 1.2 m, per (2) or (3),
(b) an underside over 0.6 m above ground protected by 0.38 mm (0.015″)
noncombustible material, unvented aluminum (CAN/CGSB-93.2-M), 12.7 mm gypsum
soffit or ceiling board (CSA A82.31-M), 11 mm (7/16″) plywood, 12.5 mm (½″) OSB
or waferboard, or 11 mm lumber. Notes A-9.10.14.5.(7) and (8).
Roof soffits
(9) LD 0.45 m (1′-5¾″) or less: none above the face. (10) LD over 0.45 m: soffit
face 0.45 m or more from the property line. (11) Facing a public way: may reach
the property line. (12) Under 1.2 m from a property line, public way centre
line, or imaginary line between buildings or fire compartments on one property:
no openings, protected as in (8)(b) but with 0.38 mm sheet steel.
Drawn: A, red is the face and gable, pink the protected projection. B, the protected soffit in pink.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.10.14.5. (page 9-84)
